Kalshi ETH Bin Distribution Trader v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for trading ETH price bin markets on Kalshi.
- Implements a trading strategy exploiting deviations from the 100% sum constraint on price bins.
- Includes built-in risk controls and configurable parameters via the Simmer UI.
- Defaults to safe paper trading mode; real trades only enabled with `--live`.
- No external pricing data needed; uses internal market consistency for trade signals.
